title: Small representatives of compact quasi-coherent derived objects
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and choose any derived category of its sheaves of modules [def-pc-derived-category], with arbitrary Hom universe $w$. Give $D_{QCoh}(X)$ the universe-$u$ coproducts of [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums]. There are a type $S$ in universe $u$ and objects $G_s$ such that every $G_s$ is compact [def-pc-compact-object], and every compact object $P$ is isomorphic to some $G_s$.

source.place: Tag 09M1 (perfect-proposition-compact-is-perfect), both implications; perfect representatives in lem-pc-perfect-complexes-compact-set

proof.text: K-injective resolutions provide small-Hom derived models on X and every open. The localization equivalences identify homology and restriction and restrict to equivalences of the quasi-coherent categories. They preserve coproducts and the additive Hom comparison maps, so they preserve and reflect compactness.

In these models, compact objects are perfect by the converse in Tag 09M1: restriction to an affine open has a coproduct-preserving right adjoint and therefore preserves compactness; the affine equivalence reduces the assertion to the finite-projective-complex criterion for compact objects of D(A). This converse is part of this intermediate argument, not supplied by perfectObjectCompact.

Use the small perfect representatives. Perfect-object compactness makes each compact. Every compact P is perfect by the preceding step and hence isomorphic to one of them. Transport the family, isomorphisms, and compactness to the chosen derived model. The empty scheme has the zero object as a representative.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedQCoh_compact_representatives (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] :
    let _ : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) := derivedQCohDirectSums X
    ∃ (S : Type u) (G : S → schemeDerivedQCohCategory X),
      (∀ s, IsCompactObject (G s)) ∧
      ∀ P : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, IsCompactObject P →
        ∃ s, Nonempty (P ≅ G s)
